# store

**Generated by sqlc. Do not edit.** Regenerate from `backend/`:

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/src -w /src sqlc/sqlc:1.31.1 generate
```

- `db.go` – the `Queries` type and `DBTX` interface (satisfied by a pgx pool or a transaction, so the same queries run inside `pool.Begin`).
- `models.go` – one struct per table.
- `*.sql.go` – one typed method per query in `../queries`.

Mapping (uuid → `uuid.UUID`, timestamptz → `time.Time`, nullable → pointer) is configured in `backend/sqlc.yaml`.
